features.name: duration_minmax_scaled
features.description: Loan duration scaled from the training-fold numeric range of 4 to 60 months and clipped to a bounded 0.0-1.0 interval.
features.expected_model_benefit: Puts loan term on a common bounded scale so Euclidean neighborhoods are not dominated by raw month counts.

features.name: log_credit_amount_minmax_scaled
features.description: Credit amount transformed with log1p, then scaled using the training-fold amount range and clipped to 0.0-1.0.
features.expected_model_benefit: Compresses large monetary differences while preserving ordering, improving distance behavior for skewed amounts.

features.name: monthly_credit_amount_scaled
features.description: Approximate financed amount per month, log-scaled and normalized against the feasible training-fold range implied by amount and duration bounds.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds a normalized repayment-shape coordinate that helps neighbors match on monthly loan intensity rather than total amount alone.

features.name: installment_pressure_index
features.description: Interaction between scaled installment commitment and scaled monthly credit amount, clipped to 0.0-1.0.
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates a bounded local-pressure coordinate so nearby rows share similar repayment burden geometry.

features.name: age_minmax_scaled
features.description: Applicant age scaled from the training-fold numeric range of 20 to 68 and clipped to 0.0-1.0.
features.expected_model_benefit: Keeps age comparable to other bounded features in nearest-neighbor distance calculations.

features.name: numeric_centroid_distance_scaled
features.description: Scale-normalized Euclidean distance from the unsupervised training-fold numeric center across duration, amount, installment commitment, age, residence duration, and existing credits.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds a generic prototype-distance coordinate that helps KNN identify rows near or far from the central numeric profile.

features.name: amount_duration_mismatch_scaled
features.description: Absolute difference between standardized credit amount and standardized duration, scaled and clipped to 0.0-1.0.
features.expected_model_benefit: Highlights rows whose amount is unusually high or low relative to term length, improving local shape similarity.

features.name: compact_low_exposure_cluster_indicator
features.description: Unsupervised rule flag for compact low-exposure loan profiles: duration at most 12 months, amount at most 2500, and installment commitment at most 2.
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates a crisp neighborhood anchor for short, smaller, lower-commitment credit profiles.

features.name: extended_high_exposure_cluster_indicator
features.description: Unsupervised rule flag for extended high-exposure loan profiles: duration at least 36 months, amount at least 5000, and installment commitment at least 3.
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates a crisp neighborhood anchor for long, larger, higher-commitment credit profiles.

features.name: liquidity_reserve_semantic_score
features.description: Semantic 0.0-1.0 score from checking_status and savings_status. Suggested rubric: checking_status <0=0.05, 0<=X<200=0.35, >=200=0.75, no checking=0.55; savings_status <100=0.15, 100<=X<500=0.45, 500<=X<1000=0.70, >=1000=0.90, no known savings=0.50; combine consistently as a smooth liquidity reserve score.
features.expected_model_benefit: Places ordered liquidity categories nearer in feature space than unrelated one-hot levels, improving cash-buffer similarity for KNN.

features.name: credit_record_semantic_score
features.description: Semantic 0.0-1.0 score from credit_history. Suggested rubric: no credits/all paid=0.25, all paid=0.35, delayed previously=0.45, existing paid=0.70, critical/other existing credit=0.85; interpolate only for normalized text variants.
features.expected_model_benefit: Converts nominal credit record phrases into an ordered similarity axis for smoother nearest-neighbor matching.

features.name: work_and_asset_stability_semantic_score
features.description: Semantic 0.0-1.0 score using employment, job, housing, and property_magnitude. Employment anchors: unemployed=0.05, <1=0.25, 1<=X<4=0.55, 4<=X<7=0.75, >=7=0.90. Job anchors: unemp/unskilled non res=0.10, unskilled resident=0.35, skilled=0.65, high qualif/self emp/mgmt=0.85. Housing anchors: rent=0.25, for free=0.35, own=0.75. Property anchors: no known property=0.15, life insurance=0.45, car=0.55, real estate=0.85. Blend consistently within 0.0-1.0.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds a continuous stability axis that makes rows with comparable employment, occupation, residence, and asset context closer.
